item.content:encoded:
Data Engineering 2026-10-23

📅 Overview · 🤖 AI Agents · 🧠 AI Models & Labs · ⚖️ AI Policy · 🗄️ Data Engineering

Generated: 2026-10-22 23:49 UTC | Vendor items: 13 | Projects: 17 | Active today: 5 | Stable releases: 4 | Prereleases (not covered): 0

Highlights

  • Snowflake accounts in AWS US East 1 using Cortex fine-tuning — migrate new model training workloads to other regions; creation stopped October 20, 2026.
  • DuckDB production users — test and migrate to 2.0.0 LTS “Cinnamon Teal” (breaking changes: Quack protocol, async I/O, VARIANT type, extensible parser); released October 21, 2026.
  • Azure Databricks workspaces with the compliance security profile — plan for Genie Code tasks in Lakeflow Jobs to be enabled by default starting November 2026.
  • Snowpark Python users calling DataFrame.to_polars() — upgrade to v1.55.3; method is now GA with Parquet default transport (performance shift) and JDBC lazy execution fix.
  • Azure Databricks users on serverless compute (env v5+, Connect Python 18.1.8+/Scala 18.1.5+) — validate df.cache()/persist() in Public Preview (on by default; admins can disable).

Databricks

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-21 Azure Databricks 🤖 Genie Code tasks in Lakeflow Jobs are now generally available Enables running prompts autonomously in Lakeflow Jobs with access to upstream task outputs and tool calls, returning a link to the Genie Code chat response.
2026-10-21 Azure Databricks 🤖 Genie Code tasks in Lakeflow Jobs are available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled starting in November 2026 Enables Genie Code tasks by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile starting November 2026.
2026-10-21 Azure Databricks Lakeflow pipelines system tables are now generally available (GA) Enables querying the lakeflow.pipelines and lakeflow.pipeline_update_timeline system tables to audit pipeline runs across the account.
2026-10-23 Azure Databricks DataFrame caching on serverless compute is now in Public Preview Enables df.cache() and df.persist() on serverless compute (requires serverless environment version 5+, Databricks Connect Python 18.1.8+ or Scala 18.1.5+); preview is on by default but admins can disable it.
2026-10-22 Azure Databricks Microsoft Entra ID connector is available in Beta Enables ingesting Microsoft Entra ID users, groups, applications, service principals, directory roles, identity configuration, and audit/sign-in logs via OAuth machine-to-machine auth with incremental ingestion for logs.
2026-10-20 Azure Databricks SurveyMonkey connector is available in Beta Enables ingesting SurveyMonkey surveys, structure, collectors, responses, and contacts via OAuth user-to-machine auth with incremental ingestion and multiple authoring options; workspace admins control access via the Previews page.

Also new: Oracle Eloqua connector is available in Beta · Asana connector is available in Beta · Lakebase Insights moves to per-project settings, with on-demand runs (Beta) · Box Audit Logs managed ingestion connector (Beta) · Screen MCP tool calls and results for jailbreaks (Beta)

Databricks CLI

  • Release: v1.22.0–v1.22.1 fix aitools skill installation to prevent downgrades and resolve GitHub API rate limits, and ensure auth login --timeout applies to browser-based OAuth.

Quiet today: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, dbt-databricks

Snowflake

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-20 Snowflake ⚠️ 🤖 Oct 20, 2026: Cortex Fine-tuning: New model training no longer available in AWS US East 1 Stops creation of new Cortex fine-tuned models in AWS US East 1 (N. Virginia) as of October 20, 2026; workloads must move to other regions.
2026-10-22 Snowflake Oct 22, 2026: Quiesce a primary failover group (General availability) Enables placing a primary failover group into read-only mode (quiesce) for maintenance or failover testing.
2026-10-22 Snowflake Oct 22, 2026: Snowflake Data Clean Rooms updates Enables collaboration edits with approver workflow for role changes, fixes REMOVE_TEMPLATE to clean up orphaned code specs preventing security scan timeouts, and upgrades the Clean Rooms Python runtime to 3.13.
2026-10-22 Snowflake IPADDRESS data type (Preview) Enables storing IPv4 or IPv6 addresses as a validated, canonical 128-bit native type with numeric comparison semantics.

Also new: Oct 16, 2026: Grok 4.7 and GLM 5.3 models (Preview) · Oct 20, 2026: dbt Projects on Snowflake updates · Oct 19, 2026: Tools for Cortex AI Gateway (Preview)

Snowpark Python

  • Release: v1.55.3 removes the experimental tag from DataFrame.to_polars() and switches its default transport to Parquet for better performance; it also fixes a timeout in DataFrameReader.jdbc on slow sources by lazy query execution. v1.55.3

Quiet today: Snowflake Connector for Python, Apache Polaris

Azure / Fabric & GCP

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-22 Azure updates [Launched] Generally Available: ABFS Vectored Read for Azure Data Lake Storage Enables compatible analytics engines to reduce request overhead for selective reads on Azure Data Lake Storage by combining nearby file ranges into fewer asynchronous storage requests.
2026-10-22 BigQuery 🤖 Feature: The AI.TRANSLATE function lets you translate text strings between languages. Enables translating text strings between languages using standard Neural Machine Translation or Translation LLM capabilities via the AI.TRANSLATE function.
2026-10-20 Microsoft Fabric T-SQL language enhancements in Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse (Preview) Enables GROUP BY ALL, ORDER BY ALL, QUALIFY, and FROM ... SELECT syntax to reduce repetitive SQL and simplify analytical queries in Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse.

Also new: Advanced NL2SQL and advanced DAX generation in Fabric data agents (Generally Available) · Explore and process multiple event types with Schema-aware Fabric Eventstreams (Preview) · Incrementally migrate and re-migrate database objects with Migration Assistant for Fabric Warehouse (Preview) · Create purpose-built custom visuals in Real-Time Dashboards with Copilot (Preview) · From mixed events to real-time action: Fabric Eventstreams Q3 2026

Open-source stack

SQLMesh

  • Release: v0.236.4 fixes virtual catalog handling for ClickHouse, prevents cascading drops in DuckLake catalogs, adds no-op warehouse create for Fabric, improves Snowflake timestamp lookups, and updates Databricks PyArrow dependency.

Apache Airflow

  • Hot issue: #75332 requests contributor testing of provider release candidates prepared on October 20, 2026, to verify stability before final distribution.

DuckDB

  • News: Hacker News and Lobste.rs announce DuckDB 2.0.0 LTS "Cinnamon Teal", a long-term support release emphasizing stability for production analytics workloads.

Quiet today: dbt Core, Dagster, dlt, Apache Iceberg, Polars, Trino

Releases this week

Project Version Date Summary
DuckDB v2.0.0 2026-10-21 Major release 2.0.0 introduces the Quack protocol, asynchronous I/O, a first-class VARIANT type, agent mode, triggers, and an extensible SQL parser.
MLflow v3.17.2 2026-10-21 Patch release adds lineage recording for dataset, scorer, and agent on mlflow.genai.evaluate runs and fixes Optuna trial tracking and sampler reseeding bugs.
Trino 484 2026-10-16 —

Across platforms

  • AI-assisted SQL authoring: BigQuery ships AI.TRANSLATE (GA, standard NMT or LLM); Databricks offers Genie Code tasks in Lakeflow Jobs (GA, agentic prompts with tool calls); Snowflake Cortex fine-tuning retracts in AWS us-east-1 only. All three platforms surface AI inside the warehouse, but(BigQuery, Databricks) add net-new functions while Snowflake restricts a training capability in one region.

Spotted

Story Source Discussion Summary
The bridge to agent-scale Git infrastructure Hacker News 67 points, 20 comments We moved a copy of 99.99999% of GitHub's repositories to Azure. Here's how per-reference quorums will bring over the rest.
Postgres recovery_prefetch can cause outages Hacker News 28 points, 0 comments Another story of something I saw in the field which surprised me. Turns out recovery_prefetch can cause outages.
Unauthorized Access to PingCAP Cloud Resources Lobste.rs 5 points, 3 comments PingCAP powers your digital transformation with a single source of truth at scale. Developed to be an open, unified, distributed SQL database solution.

Data Engineering Watch 2026-10-22

📅 Overview · 🤖 AI Agents · 💬 AI Discussions · 📚 AI Research · 🌐 Lab Announcements · ⚖️ Policy Watch · 🗄️ Data Engineering Watch

Generated: 2026-10-22 01:26 UTC | Vendor items: 12 | Projects: 17 | Active today: 3 | Stable releases: 2 | Prereleases (not covered): 0

Highlights

  • DuckDB v2.0.0 "Cyanoptera" introduces a major internal overhaul converting identifiers to a dedicated class and adopting tidy-check tooling.
  • Polars read_csv exhibits a 120× memory overhead on wide tables in the v2 series, a severe performance regression under triage.
  • Snowflake Declarative Feature Store reaches general availability with version-controlled YAML or Python definitions and plan-and-apply deployment.
  • Azure Databricks enables native Postgres logical replication to stream changes into and out of Lakebase for migrations and continuous sync.
  • Azure Databricks adds OAuth custom identity claims to service principal tokens for row-level filtering in multi-tenant scenarios.

Databricks

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-16 Azure Databricks File upload in Genie One and Genie Agents will soon be available by default for compliance security profile workspaces with supported compliance standards Starting November 15, 2026, file upload in Genie One and Genie Agents becomes available by default for compliance security profile workspaces where the compliance standard supports it, enabling natural language analysis of uploaded files alongside existing data.
2026-10-15 Azure Databricks Replicate data in and out of Lakebase with Postgres logical replication Native Postgres logical replication now supports streaming changes into and out of Lakebase, allowing migration of existing Postgres databases and continuous sync with external Postgres instances.
2026-10-19 Azure Databricks Saving an unchanged job no longer adds rows to the jobs system tables Saving a job without changes no longer writes rows to system.lakeflow.jobs or system.lakeflow.job_tasks, and change_time remains at the last actual modification, reducing audit noise across UI, API, and bundle deployments.
2026-10-19 Azure Databricks Filter data per end user with OAuth custom identity claims Custom identity claims can now be added to service principal OAuth tokens and used for row-level filtering in dynamic views or ABAC policies, enabling multi-tenant data access through a single service principal.
2026-10-16 Azure Databricks Delegate budget access with access control lists (ACLs) Budgets now support access control lists (ACLs), allowing account and workspace admins to delegate Budget Manager or Budget Viewer roles to users, groups, or service principals for granular cost governance.
2026-10-16 Azure Databricks Delegate access to Genie budgets Genie cost budgets now support ACLs, letting admins assign Budget Manager or Budget Viewer roles to specific principals for delegated management of Genie spending limits.

Overview

MLflow shipped a patch release that adds lineage tracking for generative AI evaluation runs and fixes two tracking-related bugs affecting Optuna integration. The update improves reproducibility for hyperparameter tuning workloads and ensures dataset, scorer, and agent metadata are recorded during mlflow.genai.evaluate calls. No other Databricks-maintained projects reported releases, hot issues, or notable news in the last 24 hours.

MLflow

  • Release: v3.17.2 adds lineage recording for dataset, scorer, and agent metadata on mlflow.genai.evaluate runs, and fixes two tracking issues: reseeding sampler and forwarding batch settings on MlflowSparkStudy executors, plus preventing MlflowStorage from marking Optuna trials finished prematurely. v3.17.2

Quiet today: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks CLI, dbt-databricks

Snowflake

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-21 Snowflake October 21, 2026: Declarative Feature Store (General availability) Declarative Feature Store is generally available, enabling version-controlled YAML or Python definitions of feature store resources with plan-and-apply deployment via the snow feature CLI.
2026-10-16 Snowflake Oct 16, 2026: Parquet Direct (Preview) Parquet Direct preview allows creating read-only Apache Iceberg tables from Parquet files in cloud object storage, querying data in place without copying or rewriting.
2026-10-20 Snowflake Oct 20, 2026: Sensitive Data Entitlement and Access reports (General availability) Sensitive Data Entitlement and Access reports in Trust Center are generally available for Enterprise Edition and higher, providing visibility into sensitive data access and entitlements.

Azure / Fabric & GCP

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-21 BigQuery Feature: The AI.CHUNK_DOCUMENT function is a table-valued function that splits unstructured documents into semantically coherent text chunks optimized for vector embeddings and Retrieval-Augmented Gen… BigQuery's AI.CHUNK_DOCUMENT function is generally available, splitting unstructured documents into semantically coherent chunks optimized for vector embeddings and RAG workflows.
2026-10-20 Microsoft Fabric New analytical functions in Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse (Preview) Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse preview adds MEDIAN, QUANTILE, APPROX_MEDIAN, APPROX_QUANTILE, and aggregate syntax for PERCENTILE_CONT/DISC, enabling efficient distribution analytics in T-SQL.
2026-10-21 Azure updates [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB Safe Key Rotation Azure Cosmos DB Safe Key Rotation is generally available, providing last-used timestamps for account keys to safely identify active keys before rotating or retiring credentials.

Open-source stack

Overview

DuckDB released version 2.0.0 "Cyanoptera", a major milestone that refactors internal identifiers and adopts tidy-check tooling. Polars users are reporting a severe memory regression in read_csv on wide tables, with the function consuming 120× more data memory than expected in the v2 series.

DuckDB

  • Release: DuckDB v2.0.0 "Cyanoptera" introduces a major internal overhaul, converting Identifier from strings to a dedicated class and migrating to tidy-check for development workflows. The release marks a significant architectural step for the engine. https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/releases/tag/v2.0.0

Polars

  • Hot issue: read_csv exhibits a 120× memory overhead on wide tables in Polars v2, flagged as a performance regression with medium priority. The issue is accepted and under triage, affecting Python users processing broad datasets. https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/30114

Quiet today: dbt Core, SQLMesh, Apache Airflow, Dagster, dlt, Apache Iceberg, Trino

Data × AI

  • Azure Databricks will enable file upload in Genie One and Genie Agents by default for compliance security profile workspaces, allowing natural language analysis of uploaded files.
  • Azure Databricks adds ACL-based delegation for Genie budgets so admins can assign Budget Manager or Budget Viewer roles to specific principals.
  • BigQuery releases AI.CHUNK_DOCUMENT as a generally available table-valued function that splits documents into chunks optimized for vector embeddings and RAG workflows.

Worth a Look

  • Saving an unchanged job no longer adds rows to the jobs system tables — Saving a job without changes no longer writes to system tables, reducing audit noise across UI, API, and bundle deployments.
  • New analytical functions in Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse (Preview) — Preview adds MEDIAN, QUANTILE, APPROX_MEDIAN, APPROX_QUANTILE, and PERCENTILE_CONT/DISC aggregate syntax for efficient distribution analytics.
  • Generally Available: Azure Cosmos DB Safe Key Rotation — Provides last-used timestamps for account keys to safely identify active keys before rotating or retiring credentials.

Data Engineering Watch 2026-10-21

📅 Overview · 🤖 AI Agents · 💬 AI Discussions · 📚 AI Research · 🌐 Lab Announcements · ⚖️ Policy Watch · 🗄️ Data Engineering Watch

Generated: 2026-10-21 01:27 UTC | Vendor items: 16 | Projects: 17 | Active today: 0 | Stable releases: 0 | Prereleases (not covered): 0

Highlights

  • Azure Databricks will retire DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on November 19, 2026, requiring migration to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (1017).
  • The MLflow Logs tab for AI Runtime runs replaces the Artifacts tab, adding search, filter, download, and 60‑day log retention.
  • Databricks Runtime 19 hides internal Spark Connect metrics for row filters and column masks, which may break dependent notebooks or tools.
  • Microsoft Fabric deprecates the Foundry data‑agent custom tool, ending support November 6, 2026; migration to Fabric IQ (OneLake Catalog) is required.
  • Asynchronous processing with transformWithState is now GA, enabling concurrent state operations.

Databricks

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-19 Azure Databricks ⚠️ DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is scheduled for retirement DeepSeek V4.1 Flash will be retired on November 19, 2026, and must be migrated to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (1017) using the provided guidance.
2026-10-15 Azure Databricks ⚠️ Redesigned MLflow Logs tab for AI Runtime runs The MLflow Logs tab for AI Runtime runs now supports search, filter, and download, replacing the deprecated Artifacts tab log files for new runs, with logs retained for 60 days.
2026-10-19 Azure Databricks ⚠️ Databricks Runtime 19: October 19, 2026 Spark Connect DataFrame execution metrics now hide internal operators and metrics for row filters and column masks, protecting policy execution details, which may require updates to notebooks or tools that rely on those metrics.
2026-10-19 Azure Databricks Asynchronous processing with transformWithState is now generally available Asynchronous processing for the Python transformWithState API is now generally available, enabling concurrent state operations and user logic for higher throughput with minimal code changes.
2026-10-14 Azure Databricks Transactions support both managed Delta Lake and Apache Iceberg tables Transactions are now generally available for Unity Catalog managed Delta Lake and Apache Iceberg tables, allowing atomic multi-statement transactions with BEGIN ATOMIC/COMMIT syntax when catalog commits are enabled.
2026-10-14 Azure Databricks Data Classification API is now generally available The Data Classification API and its Terraform resource are now generally available, while auto-tagging configuration remains in public preview.
2026-10-16 Azure Databricks File upload in Genie One and Genie Agents is now generally available File upload in Genie One and Genie Agents is now generally available, allowing file analysis in natural language conversations, except for consumer-only users.
2026-10-16 Azure Databricks READ METADATA privilege support for compliance security profile standards The READ METADATA privilege now supports all compliance security profile standards and is enabled by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile.
2026-10-14 Azure Databricks Workspace-level package repositories for Databricks Apps are generally available Workspace admins can now configure default Python and npm package repositories for Databricks Apps, which inherit workspace settings while allowing app-level overrides.

Snowflake

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-19 Snowflake Oct 19, 2026: Schema variables (General availability) Schema variables are now generally available in Snowflake.
2026-10-20 Snowflake Oct 20, 2026: Snowflake-provided tags (General availability) Snowflake-provided tags in the SNOWFLAKE.TAGS schema are now generally available, offering a consistent vocabulary for governance use cases like cost center, certification, sensitivity, environment, and project.
2026-10-14 Snowflake October 14, 2026: Centralized event sharing for Snowflake Native Apps — General Availability Centralized event sharing for Snowflake Native Apps is now generally available, allowing providers to route application telemetry from multiple regions to centralized accounts via event routing tables.

Azure / Fabric & GCP

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-20 Microsoft Fabric ⚠️ Retiring the Fabric data agent custom tool in Microsoft Foundry: move to Fabric IQ The Fabric data agent custom tool integration in Microsoft Foundry is deprecated and will be unsupported after November 6, 2026, requiring migration to the Fabric IQ (OneLake Catalog) tool for connecting Fabric data agents to Foundry agents.
2026-10-15 BigQuery Feature: You can now use reusable column aliases in GoogleSQL. Reusable column aliases in GoogleSQL are now generally available (opt-in), allowing aliases defined in SELECT to be referenced within the same SELECT list or WHERE clause, easing migration from other warehouses.
2026-10-14 BigQuery Feature: Conversational analytics now lets you create a conversation with all of the data sources in multiple projects, or create a conversation with a dataset. Conversational analytics now supports creating conversations across all data sources in multiple projects or with a single dataset, both generally available.
2026-10-14 BigQuery Feature: The AI.AGG function now supports the output_schema argument, which lets you specify the schema of the function output as a comma-separated list of fields. The AI.AGG function now supports an output_schema argument to define the output schema as a comma-separated list of fields, generally available.

Data × AI

  • Azure Databricks retires DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, pushing users to the updated DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (1017) model.
  • The MLflow Logs tab for AI Runtime runs adds search, filter, download, and 60‑day retention, replacing the Artifacts tab.
  • Genie One and Genie Agents gain GA file‑upload support for natural‑language file analysis.
  • Microsoft Fabric deprecates its Foundry data‑agent custom tool for Fabric IQ; BigQuery adds cross‑project conversational analytics and AI.AGG output_schema.

Worth a Look

  • Transactions are now GA for managed Delta Lake and Iceberg tables in Unity Catalog, supporting atomic multi‑statement transactions.
  • Data Classification API and its Terraform resource reach GA for programmatic sensitive‑data tagging (auto‑tagging stays in preview).
  • BigQuery adds reusable column aliases in GoogleSQL (opt‑in GA), simplifying query migration.

Data Engineering Watch 2026-10-20

📅 Overview · 🤖 AI Agents · 💬 AI Discussions · 📚 AI Research · 🌐 Lab Announcements · ⚖️ Policy Watch · 🗄️ Data Engineering Watch

Generated: 2026-10-20 01:42 UTC | Projects: 17 | Active today: 0 | Stable releases: 0 | Prereleases (not covered): 0

Highlights

  • Microsoft Fabric retires the Foundry data‑agent custom tool, requiring migration to Fabric IQ.
  • Snowflake’s Online Feature Store reaches general availability, enabling low‑latency feature serving for ML workloads.
  • Databricks releases the agentic code converter for general availability, supporting SQL conversion from T‑SQL, Snowflake, Redshift, Oracle, BigQuery and Teradata with validation and Genie Code chat.
  • Databricks makes on‑demand state repartitioning generally available, allowing dynamic resizing of shuffle partitions in Structured Streaming or Lakeflow without losing checkpoint state.

Databricks

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-15 Azure Databricks The agentic code converter is generally available for SQL conversion The agentic code converter is now generally available for converting SQL from dialects such as T‑SQL, Snowflake, Redshift, Oracle, BigQuery and Teradata into Databricks SQL queries, with validation and error fixing before writing results to a workspace folder. After conversion you can continue chatting with Genie Code about the converted files.
2026-10-13 Azure Databricks On-demand state repartitioning is now generally available On‑demand state repartitioning is now generally available, allowing you to resize the number of shuffle partitions for a stateful Structured Streaming query or Lakeflow pipeline without losing checkpoint state. This provides flexibility to scale streaming workloads while preserving state.
2026-10-13 Azure Databricks AI Runtime will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled AI Runtime is scheduled to become generally available on October 15, 2026 on AWS and Azure for workspaces without the compliance security profile enabled, and will be available by default for eligible workspaces with the compliance profile enabled in mid‑November. This lets you train and fine‑tune models on serverless GPUs without provisioning or managing the underlying infrastructure.
2026-10-14 Azure Databricks Workspace-level package repositories for Databricks Apps will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled Starting November 13, 2026, workspace‑level package repositories for Databricks Apps will be automatically enabled for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled, letting admins configure default Python and npm package repositories that apps inherit while still permitting app‑level overrides. This simplifies dependency management for Databricks Apps in compliant environments.
2026-10-15 Azure Databricks Context-based ingress policies for inbound private connectivity are now generally available Context‑based ingress policies for inbound Private Link are now generally available, enabling you to control which registered private endpoints can reach your workspace and combine endpoint rules with identity and request type conditions in a single policy. Account admins must turn on Context‑Based Ingress: Workspace Private Access Policies from the account console Previews page to use them.
2026-10-15 Azure Databricks Consumer access to query Unity Gateway services is generally available Consumer access to query Unity Gateway services is now generally available, so users with the consumer access entitlement no longer need an account admin to enable the preview to query model services or use Unity Gateway coding agent features. This can increase model traffic, and admins can set budgets, rate limits or disable direct model access for those users.

Snowflake

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-20 Snowflake October 20, 2026: Online Feature Store (General availability) Online Feature Store is now generally available and is no longer in Preview. Clients can use it for low‑latency feature serving in Snowflake ML workflows.
2026-10-13 Snowflake Oct 13, 2026: Cortex Agent SDK (Public Preview) The Cortex Agent SDK is now available in Public Preview for Python and TypeScript, allowing you to build applications that run Cortex Agents and Cortex Code, maintain conversations and threads, observe durable turns, and reconnect to long‑running work. This enables developers to create agent‑based solutions on Snowflake.
2026-10-13 Snowflake Oct 13, 2026: Gemini 4 Argon model in AI Functions (Preview) The gemini‑4‑argon model is now available in Public Preview in Snowflake AI Functions with the AICOMPLETE predicate. This gives you access to a newer Gemini model for AI‑driven SQL functions.

Azure / Fabric & GCP

Date Source Item Summary
2026-10-19 Microsoft Fabric ⚠️ Retiring the Fabric data agent custom tool in Microsoft Foundry: move to Fabric IQ Starting November 6, 2026, the earlier Fabric data agent custom‑tool integration in Microsoft Foundry is deprecated and will no longer be supported; Foundry agents that use a Fabric data agent as a custom tool must be migrated before that date. The replacement integration uses the Fabric IQ (OneLake Catalog) tool to make Fabric data agents available to agents and applications.
2026-10-14 BigQuery Feature: Metadata migration from Dataproc Metastore to Lakehouse is now generally available (GA). Metadata migration from Dataproc Metastore to Lakehouse is now generally available, permitting a one‑time backfill or dry run to move metadata to an Apache Iceberg REST catalog endpoint or a Hive catalog endpoint via the Google Cloud console, gcloud CLI, or REST API. This simplifies lifting Dataproc Metastore metadata into a lakehouse storage format.
2026-10-14 BigQuery Feature: You can publish a BigQuery Conversational Analytics agent in Gemini Enterprise. You can now publish a BigQuery Conversational Analytics agent in Gemini Enterprise, a feature that is generally available. This lets you share conversational analytics capabilities as a managed agent within Gemini Enterprise.
2026-10-13 BigQuery Feature: The AI.AGG function is generally available (GA). The AI.AGG function is now generally available in BigQuery, enabling you to semantically aggregate unstructured input data based on natural language instructions. This provides a built‑in way to perform AI‑driven aggregation without custom code.

Data × AI

  • Databricks’ agentic code converter is now generally available for converting SQL from multiple dialects into Databricks SQL, with validation and chat‑based refinement via Genie Code.
  • Snowflake’s Cortex Agent SDK enters public preview for Python and TypeScript, enabling durable agent applications, and the Gemini 4 Argon model is previewed in AI Functions for AICOMPLETE.
  • BigQuery adds generally available AI.AGG for semantic aggregation and lets users publish Conversational Analytics agents in Gemini Enterprise, while Microsoft Fabric retires its Foundry data‑agent tool in favor of Fabric IQ.

Worth a Look

  • Microsoft Fabric’s retirement of the Foundry data‑agent tool – important for compliance‑focused environments needing to migrate to Fabric IQ.
  • Snowflake’s Online Feature Store GA – core for real‑time ML pipelines, worth understanding the new capabilities and limits.
  • Databricks agentic code converter GA – useful for cross‑platform SQL migration projects; review its validation and Genie Code interaction.

Highlights

  • Databricks AI Runtime SDK replaces the deprecated serverless_gpu package in GPU environment version 6.
  • Knowledge Assistant and Supervisor Agent are now legacy; new agents should use the Agent Bricks CLI.
  • Snowflake release 10.37 introduces behavior change bundles, with bundle 2026_08 disabled by default for testing.
  • Azure Databricks makes Feature Views generally available for batch, streaming, and request‑time data.

  • Knowledge Assistant and Supervisor Agent are deprecated; Databricks recommends the Agent Bricks CLI for building custom agents.
  • Snowflake CoWork document generation is generally available, enabling AI‑driven PDF and Word creation from natural language prompts.

Worth a Look

  • Snowflake Apache Iceberg v3 table upgrades are now GA, offering enhanced table features and performance.
  • BigQuery adds cross‑region table copy capability, simplifying data movement across locations.
